content: Letter 3, to Shaykh ʿAlāʾ al-Dīn ʿAlī [Chishtī]: a letter of greeting proper to a notable Sufi, referring to khanaqah life and dhikr, ending with greetings to one Mawlānā Shams al-Dīn Muḥammad (presumably Shams al-Dīn Muḥammad b. Saʿd al-Dīn Taftāzānī, shaykh al-islām of Herat) (TMN/MS pp. 1-2). MK notes that Shāhrukh appointed ʿAlāʾ al-Dīn ʿAlī Chishtī administrator of his madrasa-khanaqah complex in Herat, completed 813/1410.
